title: Can Agentic Code Review Catch Vulnerabilities Before They Are Merged?
title_zh: 智能体代码审查能在合并前捕获漏洞吗？

paragraphs.en: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for security-focused code review, but existing benchmarks mostly derive the reviewed changes from their later fixes instead of the real-world bug-introducing commits. In this paper, we present SecPRBench , the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic security review on validated real-world code changes. More specifically, we have built an automated agentic pipeline to autonomously harvest, build, and validate massive real-world bug-introducing commits for popular software systems. To ensure precise evaluation, we also adopt LLM-as-a-judge to credit the findings matching ground-truth vulnerabilities. To date, we have collected 265 tasks from nine critical systems, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Across eight frontier models, recall ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with Grok 4.6 and GPT-6 sol ranking at the top. Our study also shows that most misses are not simply oversights: in 68% of them, the agent reports on a file that holds the flaw but argues for a different mechanism. Security-focused harnesses also behave differently: OpenAI’s Codex Security lowers recall by 8.3 points, mostly by abstaining, while Anthropic’s Defending Code harness raises it by 7.7 points, at a higher cost.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体已越来越多地被应用于以安全为重点的代码审查，但现有基准大多从其后续修复中提取被审查的变更，而非来自真实世界中引入缺陷的提交。 在本文中，我们提出了SecPRBench，这是首个用于评估智能体式安全审查在经过验证的真实代码变更上表现的综合性基准。 更具体地说，我们构建了一个自动化智能体流水线，能够自主地采集、构建并验证面向热门软件系统的大规模真实缺陷引入提交。 为确保评估的精确性，我们还采用LLM作为裁判，对匹配真实漏洞的发现给予认可。 到目前为止，我们已经从九个关键系统（包括Firefox、V8和OpenSSL，代码达数百万行）中收集了265个任务。 在八个前沿模型中，召回率介于32.5%到78.1%之间，其中Grok 4.6和GPT-6 sol位居前列。 我们的研究还表明，大多数遗漏并非单纯的疏忽：在68%的遗漏中，智能体报告的是存在缺陷的文件，但论证的却是另一种机制。 以安全为重点的框架表现也各不相同：OpenAI的Codex Security使召回率下降8.3个百分点，主要是由于放弃作答；而Anthropic的Defending Code框架则使其提升7.7个百分点，但代价更高。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and GitHub now offer agents that review code changes, such as pull requests (PRs), for vulnerabilities before merge ( Anthropic, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2025 ; GitHub, 2026 ) . A vulnerability missed at review can persist for years ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Consider a Firefox sandbox escape in which a compromised child process could make the privileged parent return an unintentionally powerful handle over inter-process communication (IPC) ( Mozilla Foundation, 2025 , CVE-2025-2857 ;) . Catching it at review requires connecting the IPC code to Windows handle semantics and the trust boundary between processes. We ask: Can today’s agents catch vulnerabilities before merge?

paragraphs.en: A diff shows a reviewer where to start looking but not what is wrong, so a security review is only as useful as its diagnosis. Unfortunately, existing benchmarks do not measure diagnosis on real changes (Table 1 ). Earlier detection datasets score a binary label on single functions ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Yildiz et al., 2025 ) , which models often get right for the wrong reasons ( Ullah et al., 2024 ) . Reproduction and exploitation benchmarks start from a known vulnerability and score an executable proof-of-concept (PoC) or exploit ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Lee and Brumley, 2026 ) . Code-review benchmarks also do not target security vulnerabilities ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Security PR-review benchmarks come closest, and MalPR-Bench scores whether the reviewer identifies the target ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, most of their vulnerable PRs revert or partially apply a later fix, which centers each diff on the repaired code, instead of using the real vulnerability-introducing commit ( Melo et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 差异（diff）能让评审者知道从哪里开始看，但并不能告诉他哪里有问题，因此安全评审的价值取决于其诊断能力。 遗憾的是，现有的基准测试并未衡量对真实代码变更的诊断能力（表 1）。 较早的漏洞检测数据集对单个函数给出二元标签（Ding et al., 2025；Yildiz et al., 2025），而模型往往因为错误的原因而得到正确结果（Ullah et al., 2024）。 复现与利用类基准测试从已知漏洞出发，评分标准是可执行的概念验证（PoC）或漏洞利用（Wang et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a；Lee and Brumley, 2026）。 代码评审基准测试同样不以安全漏洞为目标（Zeng et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 安全 PR 评审基准测试最为接近，其中 MalPR-Bench 评估评审者能否识别目标（Chen et al., 2026）。 然而，这些基准中大多数含漏洞的 PR 是回退或部分应用后来的修复，这使得每个 diff 都围绕被修复的代码展开，而不是使用真正引入漏洞的提交（Melo et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SecPRBench, a benchmark for pre-merge security review that aims to evaluate modern agentic code review on real-world bug-introducing commits. Each task gives an agent the diff of a real historical change that introduced a vulnerability, its commit message, and the repository, but no description of the flaw; the agent reports findings . A finding earns credit only if it explains the root cause of the task’s target vulnerability in the reviewed code; in Figure 1 , a bounds warning on the right call earns none. SecPRBench contains 265 buggy tasks from nine widely deployed C, C++, and Rust projects, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Each buggy task has a fixed companion that adds the later repair, on which the target should no longer be reported.

paragraphs.en: Building such pairs is challenging as advisories typically name the fix, not the introducing change, and automatic attribution can be unreliable ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . We have built an automated agentic pipeline to trace each bug’s introducing change and compose it with the later fix. Moreover, our pipeline also validates the pairs automatically, mostly by PoC replay on the parent, introducing, and fixed versions. Most cases pass mechanical validation checks based on PoC execution; the other task instances require human adjudication. For task evaluation, since no oracle checks free text, a large language model (LLM) judge, Claude Opus 5.5 (high), derives target-specific criteria from a reference built from public security records and checks each finding against them and the reviewed code.

paragraphs.en: Across eight frontier models and two security-focused harnesses, three findings stand out. Strong agents tie on easy targets but diverge on contested ones. Grok 4.6, GPT-6 sol, GLM 5.3, and Opus 5.5 each find about three in four targets and are statistically tied overall. On easy targets, which nearly all other agents find, every agent but MiniMax M3 finds at least nine in ten. On contested targets, which few other agents find, the top four still find about half, while the other four find at most one in five. Even combined, the eight models leave 23 targets unfound. Most misses are not oversights. In 68% of misses, a finding lands in a file that holds the flaw, often in the very function, but argues a mechanism the judge rejects. Scoring by location or by a binary vulnerable/safe verdict would count these as detections; MalPR-Bench similarly finds that reviewers often block a PR without identifying its flaw ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Security-focused harnesses move recall in both directions. With each backend model fixed, OpenAI’s Codex Security plugin, run as a static diff scan ( OpenAI, 2026f ) , lowers recall by 8.3 points relative to the same model in the Codex CLI, mostly by abstaining; Anthropic’s Defending Code reference harness ( Anthropic, 2026e ) raises it by 7.7 points on the tasks it completed, at higher cost and report volume. On repaired changes, the judge never rules that the removed target is still present (§ 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在八个前沿模型和两个专注于安全的测试框架上，有三项发现尤为突出。 强大的智能体在容易的目标上打平，但在有争议的目标上出现分化。 Grok 4.6、GPT-6 sol、GLM 5.3 和 Opus 5.5 各自找到约四分之三的目标，总体上在统计上打平。 在几乎其他所有智能体都能找到的容易目标上，除 MiniMax M3 外，每个智能体至少能找到十分之九。 在其他智能体很少能找到的有争议目标上，前四名仍能找到约一半，而其余四个最多找到五分之一。 即使将八个模型的结果合并，仍有 23 个目标未被找到。 大多数遗漏并非疏忽。 在 68% 的遗漏中，模型在含有缺陷的文件中给出了发现，往往就在出问题的函数中，但所论证的机制被评审否决。 如果按位置或按易受攻击/安全的二元判定来打分，这些都会被计为检出；MalPR-Bench 同样发现评审者常常在不识别缺陷的情况下阻止 PR（Chen et al., 2026）。 专注于安全的测试框架对召回率的影响有两个方向。 在固定每个后端模型的前提下，OpenAI 的 Codex Security 插件以静态差异扫描方式运行（OpenAI, 2026f），相对于同一模型在 Codex CLI 中的表现，召回率降低了 8.3 个百分点，主要原因是主动弃权；Anthropic 的 Defending Code 参考框架（Anthropic, 2026e）在其完成的任务上将召回率提高了 7.7 个百分点，但代价更高、报告量更大。 对于已修复的变更，评审从未判定被移除的目标仍然存在（§ 5.4）。

sents.zh: 即使将八个模型的结果合并，仍有 23 个目标未被找到。

sents.en: Most misses are not oversights.
sents.zh: 大多数遗漏并非疏忽。

sents.en: In 68% of misses, a finding lands in a file that holds the flaw, often in the very function, but argues a mechanism the judge rejects.
sents.zh: 在 68% 的遗漏中，模型在含有缺陷的文件中给出了发现，往往就在出问题的函数中，但所论证的机制被评审否决。

sents.en: Scoring by location or by a binary vulnerable/safe verdict would count these as detections; MalPR-Bench similarly finds that reviewers often block a PR without identifying its flaw ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 如果按位置或按易受攻击/安全的二元判定来打分，这些都会被计为检出；MalPR-Bench 同样发现评审者常常在不识别缺陷的情况下阻止 PR（Chen et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Security-focused harnesses move recall in both directions.
sents.zh: 专注于安全的测试框架对召回率的影响有两个方向。

sents.en: With each backend model fixed, OpenAI’s Codex Security plugin, run as a static diff scan ( OpenAI, 2026f ) , lowers recall by 8.3 points relative to the same model in the Codex CLI, mostly by abstaining; Anthropic’s Defending Code reference harness ( Anthropic, 2026e ) raises it by 7.7 points on the tasks it completed, at higher cost and report volume.
sents.zh: 在固定每个后端模型的前提下，OpenAI 的 Codex Security 插件以静态差异扫描方式运行（OpenAI, 2026f），相对于同一模型在 Codex CLI 中的表现，召回率降低了 8.3 个百分点，主要原因是主动弃权；Anthropic 的 Defending Code 参考框架（Anthropic, 2026e）在其完成的任务上将召回率提高了 7.7 个百分点，但代价更高、报告量更大。

sents.en: On repaired changes, the judge never rules that the removed target is still present (§ 5.4 ).
sents.zh: 对于已修复的变更，评审从未判定被移除的目标仍然存在（§ 5.4）。

paragraphs.en: Code-review benchmarks range from diff hunks ( Li et al., 2022 ) to whole PRs with repository context ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Kumar, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , but their ground truth is review comments across all concerns. Yu et al. (2024) compare LLMs with static analyzers on security defects from OpenStack and Qt code reviews, and Google’s Big Sleep, seeded with a recent SQLite commit, found a loosely related vulnerability before release ( Big Sleep team, 2024 ) . SEVRA-Bench wraps reverted historical fixes in persuasive PR descriptions ( Melo et al., 2026 ) , and Alexopoulos et al. (2026) show that such framing biases LLM security review. MalPR-Bench, the closest design, pairs malicious PRs with benign controls and scores whether a reviewer identifies a rubric-specified target, but derives most PRs from later fixes ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . SecPRBench instead presents the original change that accidentally introduced each vulnerability and was merged before the flaw was reported (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 代码评审基准的范围从 diff 代码块（Li et al., 2022）到带有仓库上下文的整个 PR（Zeng et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a；Kumar, 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b），但它们的真值是覆盖各类关注点的评审意见。Yu et al. （2024）在来自 OpenStack 和 Qt 代码评审的安全缺陷上将大语言模型与静态分析器进行比较，而 Google 的 Big Sleep 在以最近的 SQLite 提交为种子后，在发布前发现了一个关联较松散的漏洞（Big Sleep team, 2024）。 SEVVRA-Bench 将被回滚的历史修复包装在有说服力的 PR 描述中（Melo et al., 2026），Alexopoulos et al. （2026）表明这种措辞方式会使大语言模型的安全评审产生偏差。 MalPR-Bench 是最接近的设计，它将恶意 PR 与良性对照配对，并评估评审者是否识别出评分标准指定的目标，但其大多数 PR 来自后续的修复（Chen et al., 2026）。 SecPRBench 则呈现的是最初偶然引入每个漏洞并在缺陷被报告之前已被合并的原始变更（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: PaperBench and HealthBench judge free-form outputs against per-instance rubrics ( Starace et al., 2025 ; Arora et al., 2025 ) , but judges of code are swayed by response order, identifier names, and misleading comments ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and c-CRAB and ExploitBench use execution oracles ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lee and Brumley, 2026 ) . Execution cannot score an explanation, so our judge derives criteria from a reference, not a human-written rubric, and checks both the target’s mechanism and its presence in the reviewed code.
paragraphs.zh: PaperBench 和 HealthBench 依据针对每个实例的评分细则来评判自由格式的输出（Starace et al., 2025；Arora et al., 2025），但代码评判会受到响应顺序、标识符名称和误导性注释的影响（Jiang et al., 2026），而 c-CRAB 和 ExploitBench 则使用执行预言机（Zhang et al., 2026b；Lee and Brumley, 2026）。 执行无法为解释性内容评分，因此我们的评判器从参考答案中推导评判标准，而非依赖人工编写的评分细则，并同时检查目标机制的实现方式以及其在被审代码中的存在性。

paragraphs.en: Each case is built in four steps from evidence withheld from the evaluated agents (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个案例通过四个步骤构建，这些步骤基于对被评估智能体隐藏的证据（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: SecPRBench evaluates whether an agent can identify and explain a vulnerability that a proposed code change introduces. Each case centers on one target vulnerability and yields two review tasks: a buggy task built from the change that introduced the target (in partial-fix cases, a security-relevant change that failed to remove it; § 3.3 ), and a fixed companion in which the target is repaired.
paragraphs.zh: SecPRBench 评估智能体能否识别并解释某个提议的代码变更所引入的漏洞。 每个案例围绕一个目标漏洞展开，并产生两个审查任务：一个有缺陷任务，由引入该目标的变更构建（在部分修复的案例中，是指未能消除该目标的安全相关变更；§ 3.3），以及一个修复了该目标的配对已修复任务。

sents.en: SecPRBench evaluates whether an agent can identify and explain a vulnerability that a proposed code change introduces.
sents.zh: SecPRBench 评估智能体能否识别并解释某个提议的代码变更所引入的漏洞。

sents.en: Each case centers on one target vulnerability and yields two review tasks: a buggy task built from the change that introduced the target (in partial-fix cases, a security-relevant change that failed to remove it; § 3.3 ), and a fixed companion in which the target is repaired.
sents.zh: 每个案例围绕一个目标漏洞展开，并产生两个审查任务：一个有缺陷任务，由引入该目标的变更构建（在部分修复的案例中，是指未能消除该目标的安全相关变更；§ 3.3），以及一个修复了该目标的配对已修复任务。

paragraphs.en: The agent receives x = ( S , Δ , m ) x=(S,\Delta,m) : a repository snapshot S S , a diff Δ \Delta , and change text m m from the commit message. For a buggy task with introducing commit c i c_{i} and parent p i p_{i} , S S is the tree at c i c_{i} and Δ = Δ b = diff ⁡ ( p i , c i ) \Delta=\Delta_{b}=\mathrm{diff}(p_{i},c_{i}) . For a fixed companion, Δ = Δ f \Delta=\Delta_{f} is the introducing change composed with the later repair, again relative to p i p_{i} ; S S is the upstream fixing revision, which also contains intervening upstream changes (see Limitations). The agent may read any code in S S but sees no review discussion. Each task runs in an isolated container with no Git history and with network access limited to the model provider. paragraphs.en: Per-project collectors gather CVE-linked records and public project security reports, including issues without CVE identifiers, with their discussions and fixing commits (Appendix A ). We keep fixes committed from January 2025 through June 2026, and both review diffs of a case must stay within 30 files and 2,000 added plus deleted lines.

paragraphs.en: The same agent traces the affected code backward from the fix, using diffs, history search, and blame, to a candidate introducing commit c i c_{i} with parent p i p_{i} . Automatic attribution is unreliable: SZZ-style tools such as V-SZZ ( Bao et al., 2022 ) blame the lines a fix touches but struggle to identify vulnerability-introducing commits ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and agent-based tracing narrows but does not close this gap on bug-introducing commits ( Risse and Böhme, 2026 ) . We therefore accept an attribution only after validation (as detailed in § 3.3 ), and the buggy task keeps the complete change Δ b \Delta_{b} , including unrelated edits.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个智能体从修复处出发，利用 diff、历史搜索和 blame 向后追溯受影响的代码，定位到候选引入提交 c i c_{i} 及其父提交 p i p_{i} 。 自动归因并不可靠：V-SZZ（Bao et al., 2022）等 SZZ 类工具虽然能标注修复所触及的行，却难以识别漏洞引入提交（Lu et al., 2026），而基于智能体的追溯方法在缺陷引入提交上只能缩小差距、无法完全消除（Risse and Böhme, 2026）。 因此，我们只有在验证通过后才接受归因结果（详见 § 3.3），并且缺陷任务保留完整变更 Δ b \Delta_{b} ，包括无关的修改。

paragraphs.en: We build three snapshots in project-specific containers: the parent S p S_{p} , the buggy tree S i = apply ⁡ ( p i , Δ b ) S_{i}=\operatorname{apply}(p_{i},\Delta_{b}) , and the repaired tree S r = apply ⁡ ( p i , Δ f ) S_{r}=\operatorname{apply}(p_{i},\Delta_{f}) , which differs from the companion snapshot that agents review. We reuse a public reproducer, adapted to the old revision or harness if needed, or generate one with AnyPoC ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . We replay one PoC input and invocation unchanged on all three snapshots and require the target failure to be absent on S p S_{p} , present on S i S_{i} , and absent on S r S_{r} . The oracle uses sanitizer output matching the reference root cause for memory-safety failures and a behavioral check for supported logic bugs; build failures, unrelated crashes, and timeouts do not count as evidence.

paragraphs.en: Adjudicators decide the cases that replay cannot settle. Seven partial-fix cases are a narrow exception to introducing-change tasks: the reviewed repair or hardening leaves the target reachable on both S p S_{p} and S i S_{i} , while replay records its removal on S r S_{r} . We retain them only when source evidence directly links the remaining target to the attempted repair in the changed code (Appendix B ). Other cases need judgment beyond the default oracle, such as interpreting assertions, debugger traces, or races, or cannot be fully replayed on historical builds or platforms. Adjudication combines the security record, source comparison, fixing change, and available execution evidence; we retain the automated outcome alongside each decision.

paragraphs.en: On the 265 buggy changes and their fixed companions, we ask how often agents find the introduced flaw (RQ1), why they miss (RQ2), whether a security-focused harness helps (RQ3), and how they perform on fixed versions (RQ4).
paragraphs.zh: 针对这265个有缺陷的变更及其对应的修复版本，我们探究：智能体发现所引入缺陷的频率如何（RQ1）、它们为何遗漏缺陷（RQ2）、以安全为中心的测试框架是否有所帮助（RQ3），以及它们在修复版本上的表现如何（RQ4）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Grok 4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6 sol ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , GPT-6 sol, GPT-6 luna, GLM 5.3 ( Z.ai, 2026 ; GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , and MiniMax M3 ( MiniMax, 2026b ) on the same inputs, withholding the reference and the later fix (Appendix D ). Each model runs in an agent harness, the program that provides its tools and drives its loop. paragraphs.en: Strong agents tie on easy targets and separate on contested ones. Grok 4.6, GPT-6 sol, GLM 5.3, and Opus 5.5 lead, each finding about three in four targets (Table 2 ). Grok is highest at 78.1%, but no pair among the four differs significantly (Appendix F.2 ); they differ more in speed, and Opus 5.5 is the fastest of all eight. To see where agents separate, we group targets by how many of the other seven agents find them. On easy targets, which nearly all other agents find, every agent but MiniMax M3 finds at least nine in ten; on contested ones, which only a few others find, the top four still find about half, while the other four find at most one in five (Appendix F.2 ). A newer model can close that gap: with the same harness and reasoning effort, GPT-6 sol finds 58 targets that GPT-5.6 sol misses and misses only four that it finds, with the largest gains on integer overflows and logic errors (Table 8 ). As in prior security benchmarks ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , combining agents improves coverage, but here the gains shrink quickly: the three leading agents together find about nine in ten targets, and all eight find only one more than the top four (Figure 4 a). Even combined, the eight agents leave 23 targets unfound, far more than independent errors would predict (Appendix F.4 ). Training cutoffs make no clear difference: adjusted post-cutoff recall is several points lower for four of five testable models and slightly higher for GPT-6 sol, but every interval spans zero, and fixing dates cannot show training exposure (Appendix F.9 ).

paragraphs.en: Most misses are misdiagnoses, not oversights. paragraphs.en: No fixed companion receives a positive target verdict, in direct review or either harness (Table 2 ; Appendix F.7 ). This is a narrow check: a negative verdict does not show whether a report reasserts the removed flaw, so these verdicts measure neither false-positive rates nor report precision. Location overlap alone would credit about three in four companion scans: over nine in ten nonempty reports still name a root-cause file. Still, every direct-review agent but MiniMax M3 files fewer findings after the repair ( Δ \Delta Findings in Table 2 ; Figure 4 c), and the drop follows correct diagnoses: when an agent’s only finding on a buggy change is credited, its companion report is empty almost half the time, against about one in six when that finding is rejected. A fixed companion is thus a control only for its target, not a claim that the whole change is safe (Appendix F.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在直接审查或任一测试环境中，没有任何固定陪审智能体获得正向目标判定（表 2；附录 F.7）。 这是一个狭窄的检查：负向判定并不能表明报告是否重新断言了已被移除的缺陷，因此这些判定既不衡量假阳性率，也不衡量报告精确率。 仅凭位置重叠就会让大约四分之三的陪审扫描获得认可：超过九成的非空报告仍然指出了根因文件。 尽管如此，除 MiniMax M3 外，每个直接审查智能体在修复后提交的发现都更少了（表 2 中的 Δ 发现数；图 4c），而且这种下降伴随着正确的诊断：当智能体在有缺陷变更上的唯一发现被认可时，其陪审报告几乎有一半的时间是空的；而当该发现被拒绝时，这一比例约为六分之一。 因此，固定陪审智能体只是对其目标的一个对照，而不是对整个变更是安全的声明（附录 F.6）。

paragraphs.en: SecPRBench evaluates vulnerability diagnosis on real code changes, pairing 265 buggy tasks with repaired companions. Recall across eight direct-review agents ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with four agents statistically tied at the top. Strong agents tie on easy targets but separate on contested ones. Even combined, the eight agents leave 23 targets unfound. Most misses are misdiagnoses despite findings in the flawed file. Security-focused harnesses move recall in both directions: Codex Security abstains more, while Anthropic’s Defending Code harness finds more at higher cost. On repaired changes, the judge never rules the removed flaw still present, though this does not establish report precision. The automated pipeline supports refreshes from new disclosures; released tasks, reports, and verdicts let others inspect and re-grade the findings. Better diagnosis is the key remaining challenge.
paragraphs.zh: SecPRBench 在真实代码变更上评估漏洞诊断能力，将265个含缺陷任务与其修复后的配套版本配对。 八个直接审查智能体的召回率介于32.5%到78.1%之间，其中四个智能体在统计上并列最高。 强的智能体在简单目标上打成平手，但在有争议的目标上拉开差距。 即使八个智能体联合起来，仍有23个目标未能被发现。 尽管在有缺陷的文件中有发现，大多数遗漏都属于误诊。 面向安全的框架使召回率双向变化：Codex Security 弃权更多，而 Anthropic 的 Defending Code 框架以更高成本发现了更多漏洞。 在修复后的变更上，评审从未判定被移除的缺陷仍然存在，但这并不能证明报告的精确性。 该自动化流水线支持根据新披露信息进行更新；已发布的任务、报告和判定结果让其他人可以审查并重新评估这些发现。 更好的诊断能力是仍然存在的关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: SecPRBench covers publicly disclosed vulnerabilities in nine widely deployed C, C++, and Rust projects, with changes of up to 30 files and 2,000 changed lines (§ 3.2 ), so our conclusions concern security review of systems code. Its targets were later disclosed and fixed, so they may differ from flaws that remain undiscovered. Because every buggy task contains a validated target, SecPRBench measures whether agents find and diagnose known vulnerabilities, not how often ordinary pull requests are vulnerable. Fixed companions are reviewed at the upstream fixing revision, which can include intervening changes, and control only for their targets, so SecPRBench does not measure report precision (§ 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: SecPRBench 覆盖了九个广泛部署的 C、C++ 和 Rust 项目中公开披露的漏洞，其变更最多涉及 30 个文件和 2,000 行改动（§ 3.2），因此我们的结论针对的是系统代码的安全审查。 其目标漏洞后来被披露并修复，因此它们可能与尚未被发现的缺陷有所不同。 由于每个含缺陷任务都包含一个经过验证的目标，SecPRBench 衡量的是智能体能否发现并诊断已知漏洞，而不是普通拉取请求中漏洞的出现频率。 修复配对项在上游修复版本处进行审查，其中可能包含中间发生的其他改动，并且仅针对其目标进行对照，因此 SecPRBench 不衡量报告的精确度（§ 5.4）。

paragraphs.en: Of the 265 cases, 217 pass mechanical checks, mainly PoC replay on the parent, introducing, and repaired trees (§ 3.3 ). The other 48, such as partial fixes and races, rest on human adjudication of source and execution evidence, and we keep the automated outcome beside each decision. Our judge, Claude Opus 5.5 (high), is also an evaluated model, as is Sonnet 5, which drafted most references (§ 3.2 ). Switching the judge from Sonnet 4.6 to Opus 5.5 changes Opus 5.5’s own verdicts on only seven tasks, four up and three down, and the two judges agree on 96.9% of 2,143 nonempty buggy reports (Appendix F.8 ). Our manual audit supports the judge on all 25 sampled agreements and 21 of 25 disagreements (Appendix E ), and we release reports and verdicts so that other judges can re-grade them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 265 个案例中，217 个通过机械检查，主要是在父树、引入树和修复树上进行 PoC 重放（§ 3.3）。 其余 48 个，如部分修复和竞态条件，则依赖人工对源代码和执行证据进行裁定，我们在每个裁定旁保留自动化结果。 我们的评审模型 Claude Opus 5.5（high）本身也是一个被评估的模型，Sonnet 5 也是，它起草了大部分参考文献（§ 3.2）。 将评审模型从 Sonnet 4.6 切换到 Opus 5.5 后，Opus 5.5 自身的判定仅在七个任务上发生变化，四个向上、三个向下，两个评审模型在 2,143 份非空错误报告中的 96.9% 上达成一致（附录 F.8）。 我们的人工审计支持评审模型对全部 25 个抽样一致案例和 25 个不一致案例中的 21 个的判定（附录 E），并且我们发布了报告和判定结果，以便其他评审模型可以重新评分。

paragraphs.en: Each agent has one run per task, without matched token budgets, so we report tokens, cost, and time beside recall (Table 2 ); each result describes a model in its harness, not the model alone. We do not repeat runs; paired tests over all 265 tasks separate each of the four leading agents from each of the other four (Appendix F.2 ). Harness comparisons fix the backend model and reasoning effort but not prompts or budgets, so they compare each harness as a whole, in the configuration we ran (Appendix F.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体在每个任务上只有一次运行，且没有匹配的 token 预算，因此我们在召回率旁同时报告 token 数、成本和时间（表 2）；每个结果描述的是其测试框架中的模型，而非模型本身。 我们不重复运行；对全部 265 个任务的配对检验将四个领先智能体中的每一个与其他四个智能体逐一区分开来（附录 F.2）。 测试框架比较固定了后端模型和推理努力程度，但不固定提示词或预算，因此它们比较的是每个测试框架的整体，即我们所运行配置下的整体（附录 F.7）。

paragraphs.en: Public security records and fixes may appear in model training data. Agents review buggy changes without the security record, the fixing commit, Git history, or web tools (§ 3.1 ; Appendix F.1 ), and harness comparisons hold the backend model, and so its training data, fixed. For the five models with fixes on both sides of their documented cutoffs, adjusted recall after the cutoff is lower for four of them, but no difference is statistically clear (Appendix F.9 ). Because collection, tracing, and PoC replay are automated, SecPRBench can be refreshed with vulnerabilities disclosed after future training cutoffs.

paragraphs.en: The tasks are based on public security records and linked fixes. We reuse, adapt, or generate PoCs for these historical vulnerabilities only to validate task labels; the benchmark itself evaluates defensive source review. All nine projects are open source, and their code stays under its upstream licenses, such as MPL-2.0 for Firefox, BSD-3-Clause for V8, and Apache-2.0 for OpenSSL and Wasmtime. Tasks contain only public code, commit messages, and security records; we collect no personal data beyond developer names that the projects already publish. Benchmark labels do not establish a new vulnerability in a current release; any new finding requires independent validation and responsible disclosure to the affected project.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务基于公开的安全记录和相关的修复。 我们对这些历史漏洞复用、改编或生成 PoC，仅用于验证任务标签；基准本身评估的是防御性的源码审查。 这九个项目全部开源，其代码仍遵循各自的上游许可证，例如 Firefox 采用 MPL-2.0，V8 采用 BSD-3-Clause，OpenSSL 和 Wasmtime 采用 Apache-2.0。 任务只包含公开的代码、提交信息和安全记录；除项目已发布的开发者姓名外，我们不收集任何个人数据。 基准标签并不表示在当前版本中发现了新漏洞；任何新发现都需要独立验证，并向受影响的项目进行负责任的披露。

paragraphs.en: We collect candidates from two complementary sources: CVE-linked vulnerability records and public project security reports, including issues without assigned CVE identifiers. Project-specific collectors gather the associated advisories, bug reports, discussions, and fixing commits, and normalize them into candidate records containing an issue identifier, available report text, evidence of security relevance, and candidate fixing revisions. Beyond the eligibility criteria in § 3.2 , we exclude documentation-only, test-only, dependency-update, and build-metadata changes, as well as unsupported security claims. Introducing and fixing revisions must lie on the project’s mainline, and fixing revisions have committer timestamps on or after January 1, 2025, and before July 1, 2026. Table 4 records the source-specific inputs used by the project collectors. A security label is an inclusion signal, not a common severity scale across projects. Cases without CVE identifiers use project issue identifiers or publicly documented security-linked fixing commits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个互补来源收集候选数据：与 CVE 关联的漏洞记录以及公开的项目安全报告，其中包括未分配 CVE 标识符的问题。 针对特定项目的采集器收集相关公告、缺陷报告、讨论和修复提交，并将其规范化为包含问题标识符、可用报告文本、安全相关性证据以及候选修复版本的候选记录。 除了 § 3.2 中的纳入标准之外，我们还排除仅涉及文档、仅涉及测试、依赖更新和构建元数据的变更，以及缺乏依据的安全声明。 引入版本和修复版本必须位于项目的主线上，且修复版本的提交者时间戳须在 2025 年 1 月 1 日（含）之后、2026 年 7 月 1 日（不含）之前。 表 4 记录了项目采集器所使用的各来源特定的输入。 安全标签是一种纳入信号，而非跨项目通用的严重程度量表。 没有 CVE 标识符的案例使用项目问题标识符或公开记录的与安全相关的修复提交。

paragraphs.en: Before replay, structural checks cover commit hashes, task metadata, diff structure, and patch applicability. For mechanical validation, the shared validator reconstructs three snapshots from the introducing revision’s first parent: the parent S p S_{p} , the buggy tree S i S_{i} , and the repaired tree S r S_{r} . When no public reproducer exists, AnyPoC generates one from the vulnerability report, the fix, and the repository. The validator records build results, patch-application status, exit codes, sanitizer output, and execution logs. For introducing changes, validation requires the same PoC and invocation to show the target failure on S i S_{i} and no target failure on S p S_{p} or S r S_{r} . The observed failure must match the reference root cause; unrelated crashes, build failures, and timeouts do not establish a positive verdict. We inspect the recorded evidence to confirm the observed behavior, not just build or crash status.

paragraphs.en: We distinguish partial fixes in the reviewed change from those in its companion. A reviewed partial fix is a narrow exception to the requirement that a buggy task introduce the target: the same flaw may remain reachable before and after the change. Real repair commits can leave vulnerabilities unresolved; reviewers should identify why the changed logic fails to remove the target. We retain such cases only when source evidence establishes this causal link and the companion removes the target; an unrelated pre-existing flaw does not qualify. A companion that still contains the target is not a valid repaired control; one that removes it may still contain another defect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将所审查变更中的部分修复与其伴生变更中的部分修复区分开来。 已审查的部分修复是对「有缺陷的任务引入目标」这一要求的一个狭窄例外：同一缺陷在变更前后可能仍然可达。 真实的修复提交可能未能解决漏洞；审查者应识别为何变更后的逻辑未能消除目标。 仅当源代码证据确立了这一因果关系且伴生变更消除了目标时，我们才保留此类案例；无关的既有缺陷不符合条件。 仍包含目标的伴生变更不是有效的修复对照；消除了目标的伴生变更仍可能包含其他缺陷。

paragraphs.en: In Firefox issue 1948111, the introducing change adds repeated locale-string writes that can race with worker reads. A recorded browser run exercises the relevant paths without an ASan error; source comparison with the fix identifies the missing synchronization. This motivates race-aware or source-based adjudication, rather than interpreting sanitizer silence as absence of the bug. FreeType OSS-Fuzz issue 499455833 offers a complementary example: a debugger shows a point index outside the glyph’s logical zone, while historical over-allocation masks the access from ASan. Human adjudication reads this evidence alongside the source and repair.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Firefox issue 1948111 中，引入变更的提交添加了重复的区域设置字符串写入操作，这些写入可能与工作线程的读取发生竞争。 一次录制的浏览器运行会执行相关代码路径，但不会触发 ASan 错误；与修复版本进行源码比对后，才能识别出缺失的同步操作。 这促使我们采用竞争感知或基于源码的判定方式，而不是把清理器的沉默解读为漏洞不存在。 FreeType 的 OSS-Fuzz issue 499455833 提供了一个互补的例子：调试器显示某个点索引超出了字形的逻辑区域，而历史上的过度分配使 ASan 掩盖了这次访问。 人工判定会把这些证据与源码和修复方案一起对照阅读。

paragraphs.en: Let Δ b = diff ⁡ ( p i , c i ) \Delta_{b}=\operatorname{diff}(p_{i},c_{i}) and let Δ f \Delta_{f} be the composed fixed patch. The shared validator materializes S i = apply ⁡ ( p i , Δ b ) S_{i}=\operatorname{apply}(p_{i},\Delta_{b}) and S r = apply ⁡ ( p i , Δ f ) S_{r}=\operatorname{apply}(p_{i},\Delta_{f}) ; the first is the buggy-task snapshot. Validation reconstructs both changes from their common parent, whereas agents review the recorded fixing snapshot for companions. paragraphs.en: Review the proposed change for security failures. Begin with changed functions and follow relevant callers, callees, and data structures. Check whether the change breaks assumptions about types, bounds, ownership, error handling, or control flow, including exceptional paths. Read the code; do not infer safety from stated intent.
paragraphs.zh: 审查提议的变更是否存在安全缺陷。 从被更改的函数开始，跟踪相关的调用方、被调用方和数据结构。 检查该变更是否破坏了关于类型、边界、所有权、错误处理或控制流的假设，包括异常路径。 阅读代码；不要根据声明的意图推断其安全性。

sents.en: Review the proposed change for security failures.
sents.zh: 审查提议的变更是否存在安全缺陷。

sents.en: Begin with changed functions and follow relevant callers, callees, and data structures.
sents.zh: 从被更改的函数开始，跟踪相关的调用方、被调用方和数据结构。

sents.en: Read the code; do not infer safety from stated intent.
sents.zh: 阅读代码；不要根据声明的意图推断其安全性。

paragraphs.en: Report each plausible failure with a concrete location, a path to it, and its security impact. State uncertainty; a complete exploit is not required. Exclude unsupported speculation, style issues, and failures demonstrably prevented by the code. Continue reviewing after each finding.
paragraphs.zh: 对每一个合理的故障进行报告，并给出具体位置、到达该位置的路径及其安全影响。 说明不确定性；无需提供完整的漏洞利用。 排除无依据的猜测、风格问题，以及代码中可明确证明已被防止的故障。 每发现一个问题后继续审查。

paragraphs.en: In Claude Code, each finding is submitted through our reporting tool as JSON with a title, explanation, location, bug type, severity, and confidence; related locations and suggested fixes can supplement it. paragraphs.en: Our evaluation runner prompts the judge to derive task-specific criteria from the reference root cause and reference findings. The judge evaluates the agent’s final report against these criteria, using relevant diff sections selected by affected files and falling back to the full diff when necessary. Excerpts longer than 30,000 characters are truncated. The judge returns a structured verdict indicating detection, confidence, and supporting reasoning. Tasks with empty reports are counted as non-detections without a judge call, and all tasks remain in the recall denominator.

paragraphs.en: We adjudicated 50 evaluation records with LLM assistance and checked each adjudication manually. The sample contains 25 selected Sonnet–Opus disagreements and 25 randomly selected agreement controls with nonempty reports. We compared the reference, findings, verdicts, and code, including the supplied change excerpt where available.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在大型语言模型（LLM）辅助下裁定（adjudicated）了50条评估记录，并逐一人工核查了每次裁定结果。 样本包含25个精选的Sonnet–Opus分歧案例，以及25个随机抽取的报告非空的一致性对照案例。 我们比较了参考答案、发现、判定和代码，并在有提供的情况下，包括了所附的代码变更摘录。

sents.en: The sample contains 25 selected Sonnet–Opus disagreements and 25 randomly selected agreement controls with nonempty reports.

paragraphs.en: Disagreements were deliberately oversampled, so Table 7 reports each group separately; pooled percentages do not estimate overall judge accuracy. In the four cases where Opus departs from our adjudication, it broadened a target trigger or sink, supplied a missing causal step, or combined partial findings across mechanisms. Agreement concerns the binary verdict, not every supporting claim: one correct negative included a repair rationale whose decisive code lay outside the judge’s excerpt.
paragraphs.zh: 争议案例被有意过度采样，因此表7对各分组分别报告；合并后的百分比不能用来估计评判者的整体准确率。 在Opus与我们的裁决不一致的四个案例中，它扩大了某个触发条件或汇点的范围，补充了缺失的因果步骤，或将跨机制的部分发现合并在一起。 一致性仅针对二元判定结论，而非每一条支持性论断：有一个正确的否定判定，其修复理由中的关键代码并不在评判者所摘录的片段之内。

paragraphs.en: In the OpenSSL CVE-2025-9232 companion, the reference concerns an unterminated host buffer reaching strstr ; the fix adds host[sl] = '\0'; . The audited report instead alleges that the bracketed host [] yields an empty, terminated search string whose repeated matches advance past the end of no_proxy . Both judges reject target detection, consistent with our adjudication: the function and operation overlap, but the trigger and violated invariant differ. The audit does not validate neighboring findings. In curl CVE-2026-3805 (§ 5 ), GLM’s report notes that the request path points into connection-owned memory but concludes that this is a leak and a latent hazard, not a live use-after-free. Sonnet 4.6 credits the report, whereas Opus 5.5 rejects it, consistent with our adjudication.

paragraphs.en: We compare direct-review agents on all 265 tasks using exact two-sided McNemar tests, counting missing or errored runs as misses. No pair among the top four agents (Grok, GPT-6 sol, GLM, and Opus) differs significantly even before correction for multiple comparisons. After Holm adjustment across all 28 direct-review pairs, no difference is significant within the top four or among Sonnet, GPT-5.6 sol, and GPT-6 luna; all remaining pairs have p < 0.001 p<0.001 . Collapsing tasks that share an introducing commit into 254 clusters, each credited when any (or every) member is detected, leaves Grok’s comparisons with the other top agents nonsignificant even without adjustment. The other splits in this appendix use exploratory sign, Fisher, Mann–Whitney, or Spearman tests without multiple-comparison correction.

paragraphs.en: Table 8 groups the reference bug types into memory safety (use-after-free, double free, out-of-bounds access, buffer overflow, null dereference, type confusion, uninitialized memory, wild pointer), logic error, integer overflow, and concurrency (data race or race condition). Averaged over the eight direct-review agents, recall is 51.5% on logic errors and 73.1% on memory-safety flaws. Logic errors account for 13 of the 23 unfound targets. Class and project are entangled: about a third of the logic errors are in V8. Outside V8, logic-error recall remains lower than memory-safety recall for every agent, by 4–22 percentage points, although several differences are not statistically clear. The concurrency group is too small for class-level conclusions. With the same harness and reasoning effort, GPT-6 sol finds 58 targets that GPT-5.6 sol misses and misses four that it finds. GPT-6 sol’s largest class gains are 34.1 points on integer overflows and 24.4 points on logic errors.

paragraphs.en: Table 9 classifies each scanned miss from its trajectory and report. A task’s root-cause files comprise the reference finding’s location, affected files, and additional files annotated as necessary to explain the mechanism. For three tasks whose annotated paths do not match changed files at the introducing commit, we use the diff files instead. A file is opened when a read, search, or shell command names it; Codex Security is classified from its shell log. Each miss takes the first matching category: (A) never opened a root-cause file; (B) opened one but filed no finding; (C) filed findings only elsewhere; or (D) filed a finding in a root-cause file but the judge rejected its mechanism. Because the diff exposes root-cause files for nearly all tasks, category A is rare by construction and says little about search behavior. About 68% of pooled direct-review misses fall in category D. Recall is also lower when a mechanism spans more root-cause files: pooled over the eight agents, it is 69.6% for targets with one root-cause file and 38.5% for targets with five or more. The drop persists within diff size: from 76.5% to 55.1% (one vs. two or more root-cause files) among diffs of two to five files, and from 59.0% to 38.6% (one vs. five or more) among diffs of six or more files. paragraphs.en: Mean findings per scan fall for every direct-review agent except MiniMax (Table 10 ). In paired sign tests, Sonnet’s decrease and MiniMax’s increase are not statistically clear. Companion and buggy diffs have similar sizes, and median output tokens rise for every agent, so fewer findings do not reflect lower token use. Pooled over the eight direct-review agents, when a buggy report’s only finding is credited, the companion report is empty 44.0% of the time, against 16.0% when that finding is rejected. paragraphs.en: Raw recall gains on newer fixes are sensitive to case mix (Figure 5 ).
